scope: Complete cutoff-47 lower-bound census of the twelve single-mode principal-submap drops of the q96 F8 hyperoval map. Each known-order fit is a lower bound; every one is above 1/sqrt(2). The mode-11 drop reproduces the q94 pilot. No complete profile, uniform physical type, transfer, or score change is claimed. Multi-mode and coordinate-substitution changes are outside this census.
